<thought>To find the template for electrophilic aromatic bromination, I will search the template catalog for a reaction that forms a halide (Br) on an aromatic carbon. I will use the target molecule SMILES from the available data (the first SMILES string) and specify that a halide is formed. This should return the appropriate template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(Cl)(=O)C1=CC(F)=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
